qualification.education_qualification: B. Pharmacy, Diploma in Pharmacy, Diploma in Dental Hygienist/ Class-I DH/ DORA, Class 8th, Literate
qualification.details: Pharmacist: B. Pharmacy from a recognized institute, Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized council of India & 3 years experience. Dental Hygienist: Diploma in Dental Hygienist/Class-I DH/DORA course (Armed Forces) & 3 years experience. Female Attendant: Literate, 05 years experience in civil/Army health institute. Chowkidar: Class 8th or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel. House Keeper: Literate & 05 Yrs service.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available - 2 for Pharmacist, 1 for Dental Hygienist, 1 for Female Attendant, 1 for Chowkidar, and 1 for House Keeper.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Pharmacist: B. Pharmacy from a recognized institute, Diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized council of India & 3 years experience. Dental Hygienist: Diploma in Dental Hygienist/Class-I DH/DORA course (Armed Forces) & 3 years experience. Female Attendant: Literate, 05 years experience in civil/Army health institute. Chowkidar: Class 8th or GD Trade for Armed Forces personnel. House Keeper: Literate & 05 Yrs service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS recruitment is 12th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Pharmacist post in the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary structure for the Pharmacist position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Pharmacist position is Rs. 36,500/- per month, as per the ECHS recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Pharmacist role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Pharmacist role, candidates must possess a B. Pharmacy degree or a Diploma in Pharmacy with 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this ECHS recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these ECHS posts will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ECHS recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, www.echs.gov.in, and the direct link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the interview date for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview date for the ECHS recruitment is scheduled for 14th August 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q10. Which city is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the city of Bengdubi in West Bengal.
